content.text: issuetap answers a catalog probe with the wrong kind of no.
GET /rest/api/3/project/TAP/versions   -> 404 "No project could be found with key 'TAP/versions'."

The sibling routes are honest; these two are not. internal/api/jira.go getProject takes the remainder of the path as a project key, so "TAP/versions" becomes the key it cannot find. A client probing the catalog concludes the project does not exist — which is the exact failure TestAdversarialUnsupportedIsNotEmptySuccess exists to prevent, and it contradicts the repo rule that an unimplemented route is 501 unsupported_endpoint, never a plausible lie.

Fix shape: register GET /rest/api/{v}/project/{key}/versions and .../components as Unsupported so they 501, with rows in Inventory() and COMPATIBILITY.md. Do not implement a version catalog here unless gadak actually needs one — this issue is only about answering with the truth.
Gate: curl both paths → 501 with issuetap.code=unsupported_endpoint, never 404.
Found by the Jira-surface gap sweep (track A, score 7/10 — cheap honesty fix).
